licence.renewsTogether.value: Financial statements are submitted with the renewal, with three months allowed after financial year end to prepare them. Third party approvals must be in place before a regulated licence is issued. Signatory DocuSign or e-legal confirmation is needed if it was not done in the first 12 months. Lease: unknown.
licence.renewsTogether.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), IFZA, renews together (official IFZA renewal guide, CONFIRMED. REPORTED only: consultancies say the renewal quotation covers licence registration, establishment card renewal and the commercial licence fee); https://ifza.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/how-to-renew-your-general-trading-license-with-ifza-official-guide.pdf ; https://cdn.ifza.com/marketing/FAQs%20Update_.pdf

licence.afterExpiry.value: An expired licence cannot be used to trade, banks may suspend accounts, and fines may be imposed. Amendments cannot be made on an expired licence. A grace period exists but its length is not given, and portals are blocked once it ends. If not renewed, the licence may be struck off the register and visas may be cancelled or marked absconding. No official day thresholds found.
licence.afterExpiry.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), IFZA, late renewal (official IFZA guide and IFZA article on missed renewal, CONFIRMED; consistent with the existing licence.lateRenewalFine value); https://ifza.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/how-to-renew-your-general-trading-license-with-ifza-official-guide.pdf ; https://ifza.com/en/missed-trade-license-renewal-uae/
